content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Careers page of the official IPRC website, www.iprc.gov.in, between 15 September 2026, 10:00 Hrs and 24 October 2026, 16:00 Hrs. Register and fill in the online application form. Candidates registered on the National Career Services (NCS) portal may also apply through the same process. Upload a recent photograph (JPEG, formal dress, max 1 MB) and signature (JPEG, aspect ratio 7:2, max 1 MB). Upload scanned copies of required certificates/testimonials as applicable to your post (see Documents section below). Select your preferred city (Tirunelveli or Chennai) for the Written Test - this choice is final and cannot be changed later. Pay the application fee online via the SBI e-Payment gateway using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI. Verify all entered details carefully, since the online application cannot be edited after final submission. Download and preserve the generated Application Form for your records. There is no need to send a printout to IPRC.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificate and mark sheet of SSLC/SSC/Matriculation/10th Standard Certificate and mark sheets of HSC/12th Standard (if applicable) Certificate and mark sheets of the relevant Diploma or ITI qualification Aadhaar Card (or PAN Card/Voter ID/Driving Licence in its absence) Caste/Community/Income & Asset Certificate for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable Disability Certificate for PwBD candidates, where applicable Discharge Certificate for Ex-Serviceman candidates, where applicable Experience certificate (Cook 'A' post only) Preliminary Medical Examination (PME) Certificate (Fireman 'A' post only) Bank passbook front page (for fee refund purposes)

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Out of the 4 Fitter vacancies, 1 is reserved for Ex-Servicemen. Out of the 3 Machinist vacancies, 1 is reserved for PwBD (Orthopaedically Handicapped – OH). Out of the 3 Fireman ‘A’ vacancies, 1 is reserved for Ex-Servicemen. Cook ‘A’ applicants’ experience certificates must be issued by a well-established Hotel/Canteen; certificates from individuals will not be accepted. Fireman ‘A’ applicants must satisfy prescribed Physical Fitness Standards and upload a Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate with the online application. Interested candidates should visit iprc.gov.in for detailed information, guidelines and applying; the portal is open for applications only from 15.09.2026 to 24.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has ISRO IPRC advertised in 2026?
faq.answer: ISRO Propulsion Complex has advertised 22 posts across 9 post codes – Technical Assistant, Technician ‘B’ (6 trades), Cook ‘A’ and Fireman ‘A’ – vide Advertisement No. IPRC/RMT/2026/01 dated 12.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application portal is open from 15 September 2026 to 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Technician ‘B’ posts?
faq.answer: A pass in SSLC/SSC/Matric (10th Standard) along with an ITI certificate (NTC or NAC from NCVT) in the relevant trade – Turner, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, Refrigeration & AC, or Electrician.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Cook ‘A’ post?
faq.answer: A pass in SSLC/SSC/Matric plus 5 years’ experience as a Cook in a well-established Hotel/Canteen, with an institutional experience/skill certificate produced during the Skill Test.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Fireman ‘A’ post?
faq.answer: A pass in SSLC/SSC/Matric, meeting the prescribed Physical Fitness Standards, and uploading a Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate with the online application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for these posts?
faq.answer: Technical Assistant is at Level 7 (Rs.44,900–Rs.1,42,400); Technician ‘B’ is at Level 3 (Rs.21,700–Rs.69,100); Cook ‘A’ and Fireman ‘A’ are at Level 2 (Rs.19,900–Rs.63,200).

faq.question: Q7. Where can I apply for ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through iprc.gov.in.
